title: High Availability GCP Web Application Architecture
overview: This solution delivers a robust, globally available web application architecture on Google Cloud Platform designed to effortlessly support 100,000 concurrent users with automated disaster recovery and low latency.

nodes.label: Web End Users
nodes.purpose: Represents the 100,000 active users accessing the web application globally.

nodes.label: System Administrators
nodes.purpose: Manages platform operations, infrastructure deployments, and security oversight.

nodes.label: Next.js Frontend
nodes.purpose: Provides high-performance server-side rendering and responsive user interfaces.

nodes.label: Firebase Hosting
nodes.purpose: Delivers static assets and frontend code globally via a fast CDN edge infrastructure.

nodes.label: Node.js Backend
nodes.purpose: Executes core business logic and REST API operations to serve user requests.

nodes.label: GKE Compute Cluster
nodes.purpose: Orchestrates containerised backend services with automated horizontal scaling across regions.

nodes.label: Cloud Load Balancing
nodes.purpose: Distributes incoming traffic across multi-region backends with automated failover.

nodes.label: Cloud CDN
nodes.purpose: Caches static content at edge locations to minimize user latency and origin load.

nodes.label: Cloud SQL Database
nodes.purpose: Persists transactional relational data with cross-region replication for disaster recovery.

nodes.label: Memorystore Redis
nodes.purpose: Stores user sessions and caches frequent queries for low-latency responses.

nodes.label: Cloud Storage
nodes.purpose: Stores durable user media files and system backups.

nodes.label: IAM & Secret Manager
nodes.purpose: Enforces least privilege access and securely manages application secrets.

nodes.label: Cloud Armor WAF
nodes.purpose: Protects the web application against DDoS attacks and layer 7 vulnerabilities.

requirement_mapping.requirement: Serve web traffic efficiently to 100,000 users
Failover mechanism in case of a regional outage
Low latency for global or regional users
RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and RPO (Recovery Point Objective) definition for disaster recovery

assumptions: Standard web application architecture with a database and backend services is sufficient.
Multi-region or multi-zone GCP deployment is required for high availability and disaster recovery.
Application containers are stateless and ready for horizontal auto-scaling on GKE.

technology_stack.purpose: Frontend framework supporting server-side rendering and global performance.
Global static content hosting and edge distribution.
Asynchronous backend runtime handling concurrent user API requests.
Container orchestration and automated horizontal pod autoscaling.
Global anycast HTTP(S) load balancing and multi-region failover.
Global edge caching for static assets and reduced origin load.
Managed relational database with cross-region replication for disaster recovery.
In-memory Redis cache for fast session management and query acceleration.
Durable object storage for user media and system backups.
Least privilege access control across all Google Cloud resources.
DDoS protection and Web Application Firewall security policies.

security_considerations: Enforce TLS 1.3 encryption for all traffic in transit across the load balancers and services.
Protect against layer 7 DDoS attacks and web vulnerabilities using Cloud Armor WAF rules.
Centralize credential and secret management securely via Secret Manager.
Apply the principle of least privilege across all GCP IAM roles and service accounts.
scalability_considerations: Deploy GKE Horizontal Pod Autoscalers linked to CPU and request metrics to handle 100,000 concurrent users.
Utilize Cloud CDN and global load balancing to offload static traffic and optimize global user latency.
Implement Memorystore Redis clustering to prevent database bottlenecks under heavy read loads.
future_enhancements: Incorporate automated canary deployments and progressive delivery pipelines via CI/CD.
Expand multi-region active-active database configurations using Google Cloud Spanner for zero RPO.
Integrate advanced AI-driven anomaly detection for real-time security monitoring.
